title: Package 01 Foundation Bootstrap
statement: First structural implementation package added safety foundation while legacy commercial behavior remained active.
notes: Builder Brain did not exist before this cycle; learnings were seeded afterward.

title: Builder Brain V2 review and hardening
statement: Review feedback was converted into proportionality, semantic schemas, provenance, generated index, metrics and license triage.

title: Package 00R reconciliation, security and release baseline
statement: The audited GitHub baseline was hardened and made reproducible without migrations, production deployment or changes to real commercial data.
notes: Deferred Supabase/Auth/Company 360 and rejected direct import of non-canonical Package 02/03 changesets.

title: Package 04R Sync Bridge and Conflict UX
statement: Package 04R replaced silent revision-conflict overwrite behavior with durable local-first recovery, explicit human review, auth-safe foreground outbox delivery and serialized writes, then passed CI and merged through PR #7.
notes: PR #7 merged as 5d2d8aa5d1541010e03d2ca1926ba76a60efb3eb after workflow run 36283581505 succeeded on the final PR head. No real commercial data migration or Supabase remote activation occurred.
